scan.stopped_meaning: stopped=true: the run ended early (time budget or SIGTERM) before every due repo was tried; the rest keep their last good value.
scan.coverage_note: fresh = repos with status ok checked on the scan date; carried_over = repos whose last good value from an earlier scan is kept (fresh + carried_over = scanned_ok); partial = repos whose attempt in the run returned only some paths (their earlier good value is kept); stopped = the run ended early.
